headline: Town boards prepared for Special Town Meeting on golf course irrigation, contracted a 2027 drone show, and approved a residential septic conversion.
synopsis: Ahead of Special Town Meeting, the Golf Committee finalized its approach to seek additional Community Preservation Act funding and extend existing funds for course irrigation. The Tricentennial Committee signed a contract for a 200-drone show on New Year's Day 2027 and continued preparations for town anniversary events and commemorative brick sales. The Board of Health approved a wetland setback septic variance to permit converting a commercial site on Breakneck Hill Road into a single-family home. Staff also reported that municipal flu vaccination supplies are running low as scheduled clinics conclude across town departments and schools.

highlights.title: Irrigation funding strategy for Special Town Meeting
highlights.why: The Golf Committee agreed to keep its Town Meeting warrant article intact without seeking floor amendments, requesting roughly $350,000 in new Community Preservation Act funds, an extension of $550,000 in prior funds, and $100,000 from its revolving account.

highlights.title: Drone light show contract for Tricentennial kickoff
highlights.why: The committee executed a contract for a 15-minute, 200-drone light show on January 1, 2027, which will launch from St. Mark's field with designated viewing at Woodward School and the Town House.

highlights.title: Septic variance for 66 Breakneck Hill Road
highlights.why: The Board of Health approved an 85-foot setback from bordering wetlands and an upgraded nitrogen-reducing treatment system to allow a commercial property to be converted into a four-bedroom residence, contingent on Conservation Commission review.

highlights.title: Revolving fund support for Audubon certification
highlights.why: The committee voted to pay $500 in membership dues and authorized up to $4,500 from its revolving fund to hire a consultant to finish the golf course environmental certification process.

highlights.title: Summer Nights 2027 music festival planning
highlights.why: The committee advanced plans to expand the 2027 Summer Nights event into a large music festival on the Neary School grounds, including an afternoon contra dance and multiple stages.

looking_ahead.what: Special Town Meeting, including a vote on the golf course irrigation funding article
